Kit summary

Cold-Blooded StrikeBasic
Deals 2 stages of 50% ATK DMG and 50% ATK [Bleed] DMG each to a single enemy. Meanwhile, each stage has a 60% chance to inflict 1 layer of [Bleed] for 2 turns.
Merciless BladeActiveExclusive Lv.1
Deals 100% ATK DMG to all enemies, with a 80% chance to inflict 1 layer of [Bleed] for 2 turns. Afterward, grants self [Flying Blade] for 1 turn, during which Merciless Blade will be upgraded to Deadly Blade: Deals 2 stages of 60% ATK DMG and 85% extra ATK [Bleed] DMG each to all enemies. Meanwhile, increases the extra DMG dealt by 10% for every 1 layer of [Bleed] they have, up to 100%.
Bloodlust Blade Lv.1Alicia acts for 1 extra turn after Merciless Blade is cast; Deadly Blade deals 3 stages of DMG and refreshes the duration of all enemies' [Bleed] after the 3rd stage.
Ice HunterPassiveExclusive Lv.2
When Alicia is killed and there is at least 1 ally alive, Ice Hunter will appear and take her place to continue the battle, with 50% of self Max HP (which is 70% of Alicia's Max HP). Ice Hunter is immune to all buffs and debuffs. Meanwhile, at the end of Ice Hunter's 3rd turn, Alicia will be revived with the same HP percentage as the Ice Hunter's if Ice Hunter still survives.
Bloodlust Blade Lv.2Increases the [Bleed] DMG dealt by Alicia by 15%. Alicia now reappears at the end of Ice Hunter's 2nd turn if Ice Hunter still survives, under which condition Alicia refreshes the CD of all her skills and acts immediately for 1 turn.
Bloodlust ChaseActiveExclusive Lv.3
Deals 3 stages of 110% ATK DMG and 110% ATK [Bleed] DMG each to a single enemy. Meanwhile, each stage has an 80% chance to inflict 1 layer of [Bleed] for 2 turns. Besides, extra effects take place based on the number of [Bleed] layers the target has before each stage deals DMG: if there are no less than 2 layers, this stage deals 40% more DMG; if there are no less than 4 layers, there is a 50% chance to additionally inflict 1 layer after this stage successfully inflicts [Bleed].
Bloodlust Blade Lv.3Reduces the layers required to trigger Bloodlust Chase's extra effects by 2; meanwhile, reduces the CD of Bloodlust Chase by 1 turn for every 2 layers of [Bleed] successfully inflicted when casting Bloodlust Chase.
Deadly BladeActiveExclusive Lv.1
Deals 2 stages of 60% ATK DMG and 85% extra ATK [Bleed] DMG each to all enemies. Meanwhile, increases the extra DMG dealt by 10% for every 1 layer of [Bleed] they have, up to 100%.
Bloodlust Blade Lv.1Alicia acts for 1 extra turn after Merciless Blade is cast; Deadly Blade deals 3 stages of DMG and refreshes the duration of all enemies' [Bleed] after the 3rd stage.
Stand Your GroundPassive
Increases Ice Hunter's DEF by 60% of self initial ATK.
